prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective moving steadily forward through a dimly lit pathway lined with traditional red torii gates at Fushimi Inari Taisha in Kyoto, Japan. The camera advances slowly, capturing the vertical alignment of the torii gates that create a tunnel-like effect, their vibrant red color standing out against the dark, rainy night. As the viewer progresses, the camera angle remains level, focusing on the path ahead while the surrounding environment is shrouded in mist and shadows. The rain gently falls, adding a subtle sheen to the stone pathway and creating a serene yet somber atmosphere. The camera continues its forward motion until it reaches a set of stairs leading up to another torii gate, where the scene transitions to an outdoor natural setting. The camera pans slightly to the right, revealing dense foliage and trees partially obscured by the darkness and rain. The lighting becomes even more subdued as the viewer moves further into the forested area, with only faint ambient light filtering through the canopy above. The entire sequence maintains a consistent pace and direction, emphasizing the quiet solitude of the nighttime walk through this iconic shrine.
